question: Should Google Meet attendance CSV intentionally add a leading apostrophe to formula-like cells, accepting the observable raw-value change to make default spreadsheet imports non-executable?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but automation cannot decide whether spreadsheet safety outweighs exact raw-value preservation for downstream CSV consumers.

options.title: Accept safer CSV values
options.body: Approve the current sink-local apostrophe neutralization as the Google Meet attendance export contract.

options.title: Require another export contract
options.body: Pause the PR and choose an alternative encoding or explicit safe-export mode if exact raw values must remain the default.

recommendation.title: Accept safer CSV values
recommendation.body: Approve the current sink-local apostrophe neutralization as the Google Meet attendance export contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The package collaborator signal makes steipete the best available owner for the user-visible export-contract choice.
